Game Overview

At its heart, Merge Ant: Insect Fusion is a arcade game about command a tiny ant army and engage in strategic battles. Merge identical insects to create powerful new species, evolving your force into an unstoppable swarm. Easy to learn drag-and-drop mechanics blend with strategic depth in chaotic auto battles. Unleash rare units and dominate the insect kingdom.
